sources.entry: flask-socketio - Socket.IO integration for Flask applications.

summary.one_liner: Flask-SocketIO adds Socket.IO real-time, bidirectional event communication to Flask applications.
summary.what_it_does: The package integrates the Socket.IO protocol into Flask apps. Developers create a SocketIO object wrapping a Flask app, then register event handlers with a decorator such as @socketio.event. Handlers can send replies back to the client with emit(). The server is started with socketio.run(app) in place of the normal Flask run call. The README shows only a minimal example and installation via pip; it does not detail further features in this text.
use_cases: real-time updates in a Flask web app
bidirectional messaging between browser and server
pushing live notifications to web clients
adding websocket events to an existing Flask project
how_to_run: Create a Flask app and wrap it with socketio = SocketIO(app)
Define event handlers with @socketio.event and reply using emit()
notable: Decorator-based Socket.IO event handlers (@socketio.event) inside Flask apps
Uses emit() to send responses back to clients
Installs with a single pip command
caveats: README gives no details on deployment, scaling, or supported async servers
README text provided is brief; full documentation is referenced via external links only
